source: Harness-Bench: Measuring Harness Effects across Models in Realistic Agent Workflows, arXiv:2605.27922v2 (15 Oct 2026), Table 2 (general tasks, mean Score over the 274 tasks, percent), read at arxiv.org/html/2605.27922; the pooled rows from harness-bench.ai/leaderboard.html (Delivery Quality and Resource Use, all evaluations). Fetched 2026-11-24.
note: Score is the mean oracle score of an attempt; R0.8 the share of attempts scoring at least 0.80, which is the benchmark's pass threshold; R1 the share with full credit. The paper ran no Claude model. Its runs are in Debian containers with the semantic judge; this repository's runs are on Windows, on the tasks its check admits, without the judge.
